overlap.$description: Overlap between avatars for tight, cohesive grouping

overlap-lead.$description: Overlap after lead avatar for visual separation from lead

overlap-tight.$description: Tighter overlap after lead creates cohesive subgroup

spread.$description: Spacing when hovering (neighbors spread out for visibility)

scale.$description: Scale factor for hovered avatar (slight enlargement for emphasis)

duration.$description: Animation duration for hover spread effect

easing.$description: Animation easing function for hover spread effect

gap.$description: Gap between avatar group and counter (no overlap)
